# Per-card live evidence COVERAGE (J-ALL-CARDS; generated by coverage_table.py, W1 10-20)

Every card / evolution / hero form in the SIM card table (206 records, device table 10-12 names). Live evidence from the census of 1207 frame-logged matches (10-15..10-20, any account) of which 1102 ext logs since 10-16; 'all logs' = coverage/census_cards.py over 2054 matches since 10-07.

Verdict (ext-log plays, the J1/J5 unit; owner rule n >= 30 per card): covered 159, event-only 21, thin 15, NEEDS BATTLES 11. Targeted battles needed (at ~6 plays of the card per battle, a guess to calibrate): 80 card-battles over 26 cards; one battle covers up to 8 cards of one deck.

Columns: plays all logs (both sides) | plays in frame logs | plays in ext logs (graded) | matches with the card | J2 casts (spells) | J2 Tornado exposures as victim | J3 king-activation events with it in king reach | J5 deploy observations (bodies) | J6 river crossings (bodies) | (level, hp) triples seen | static vs device / live hp | verdict | battles
